tieOut.heading: Budget and capacity
tieOut.untracedBody: They are not counted in any row above, so the delivered and capacity figures are low by that much.

owners.heading: Who answers for each portfolio
owners.body: Their automatic work and its approvals go to them.

investment.heading: Investment balance
investment.intro: Direction for funded work. Bug fixes normally count as repair.
investment.empty: No funding scope is assigned to you. The recorded budget owner can set the allocation.
investment.unavailable: Allocation is unavailable. Recorded ownership or policy needs review before using this budget.
investment.inactive: This allocation has expired or is not yet active. Save a renewed allocation to use it for future work.
investment.measured: {$repair}% repair among classified tokens · {$tokens} known tokens
investment.coverage: {$known} measured attempts · {$classified} · {$unknown} attempts with unknown usage. External agent spending is unobserved.
investment.gapExplanation: Unassigned attempts do not enter your allocation. Attempts with an unknown organization are outside this report.
investment.preferenceWaiting: Automatic preference is waiting for sufficient, recent coverage.
investment.preferRepair: Prefer repair within this funding scope.
investment.preferNew: Prefer new work within this funding scope.
investment.withinTolerance: The measured balance is within tolerance.
investment.defaultDetails: Versioned default: development-investment.default.v1. No owner override is recorded.
investment.balance: Balance repair and new work · 50% repair
investment.steering: Prefer underfunded work when coverage is sufficient
investment.installationExplanation: Use this scope for matching work without room or portfolio funding on this installation. Other installations keep their own bindings.
investment.anotherOwner: Another owner funds this work. Ownership must be resolved before rebinding.
investment.successor: Recorded ownership has changed. Confirm the successor funding scope; historical spending stays with its original owner.
investment.saveFailed: The change could not be saved. Reload to check its current state before retrying.
investment.concurrentChange: The allocation changed while you were editing. Reload before trying again.
investment.ownerRequired: The recorded funding owner must authorize this change.
investment.installationLinkIntro: Funding follows its owner and purpose.
